headline: Public Safety Committee discussed the Burlington Forward resolution and a proposed public safety response team resolution; took no action on either.
summary: The committee held a work session on the Burlington Forward resolution to prepare for a City Council report and discussed a resolution to expand supplemental public safety response proposed by Councilor Singh. No action was taken on either item. The committee also heard public comments on the resolutions and on public safety response teams.
plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
 
Public Safety Committee 
Wednesday, September 9, 2026 
Remote via Zoom/In-Person in Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 1st Floor, City Hall, 
Burlington, Vermont   
DRAFT MINUTES 
  
Members Present:  Buddy Singh (Chair), Melo Grant, Laura Sanchez-Parkinson 
  
Staff Present: Hayley McClenahan (Assistant City Attorney) 
 
Public Present: Chris McGrath, Romeo Von Hermann (Police Commissioner) 
 
Meeting called to order at 5:32 PM by Councilor Singh. 
  
1.   Adopt the Agenda 
     1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
  
Motion to adopt the agenda as amended on Civic Clerk with the addition of Item 4.02.   
 
Motion by Councilor Grant, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2.    Adopt Minutes 
      2.01 Motion to adopt draft minutes from August 27, 2026 and August 31, 2026 meetings 
 
Motion to adopt the draft minutes from August 27, 2026 and August 31, 2026 meetings as 
written.  
 
Motion by Councilor Grant, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
3.   Public Forum 
     3.01  Verbal Comments 
 
Chris McGrath commented on the purpose of the Burlington Forward resolution, stating that the 
Constitution and VT State Constitution only refer to “safety” once, and that the Committee 
should consider the meaning and use of the word in the resolutions being discussed.   
 
Romeo Von Hermann, Burlington Police Commissioner, stated hopes for the Committee to keep 
the public’s interests in mind while developing both resolutions and that they find common 
ground to move forward with a resolution that the city can be united behind.   
 
Andre Clark of Ward 2 with Street CATs-Burlington and Vermont Community Wash & Learn 
expressed concerns with public safety response teams and expanding supplemental public safety
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
resources, particularly regarding using volunteers when there are city staff and social 
organizations who are already trained.  Clark stated being in favor of more funding for existing 
programs and resources that have formal vetting practices for staff and volunteers, as opposed to 
a community organized volunteer public safety response team.  Clark also shared there will be a 
parking lot dance party at College Street Congregational Church over the weekend that the 
public is invited to attend.   
 
Public Forum closed at 5:43 PM. 
 
4.   Burlington Forward 
     4.01  Work Session on Burlington Forward 
 
The Committee discussed their approach and further changes to the Burlington Forward 
resolution in preparation for the City Council report due Monday.  No action taken.  
 
     4.02  Discussion on Resolution to Expand Supplemental Public Safety Response 
 
The Committee discussed the resolution proposed by Councilor Singh.  No action taken.  
 
5.  Adjournment 
     5.01 Motion to Adjourn 
 
The meeting was adjourned with no objection at 7:30 PM.
